import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Define coordinates
point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([63.8577134531586, -22.413665983340525])
grindavik = ee.Geometry.Point([63.84, -22.45])  # Grindavik approximate location

# Date range: January 16, 2024
date_start = '2024-01-16'
date_end = '2024-01-17'

# Use Landsat 8 Collection 2 with thermal bands
collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .filterBounds(point1) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50))

# Check if collection has data
img_count = collection.size().getInfo()
print(f"Landsat 8 images found: {img_count}")

if img_count == 0:
    print("No Landsat 8 data found on Jan 16, 2024")
    print("C1")
else:
    # Select first valid image
    img = collection.first()
    
    # Cloud mask using QA_PIXEL
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    dilated_cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)
    cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 8).eq(0)
    cloud_mask = dilated_cloud.And(cirrus)
    
    # Get thermal band (Band 10, brightness temperature)
    # Convert to surface temperature using scale factor
    thermal = img.select('ST_B10').multiply(0.0003).add(0.1)  # Convert to Kelvin then Celsius
    thermal_masked = thermal.updateMask(cloud_mask)
    
    # Extract temperature at both points
    temp1 = thermal_masked.sample(point1, 30).first().get('ST_B10').getInfo()
    temp2 = thermal_masked.sample(grindavik, 30).first().get('ST_B10').getInfo()
    
    # Count valid pixels
    count1 = thermal_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=point1.buffer(100),
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('ST_B10').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Valid pixels at point1: {count1}")
    print(f"Temperature at point1: {temp1}")
    print(f"Temperature at Grindavik: {temp2}")
    
    if count1 == 0 or temp1 is None or temp2 is None:
        print("No valid pixels after cloud masking")
        print("C2")
    elif temp1 > temp2:
        print(f"Point1 ({temp1:.2f}K) > Grindavik ({temp2:.2f}K)")
        print("A")
    else:
        print(f"Point1 ({temp1:.2f}K) <= Grindavik ({temp2:.2f}K)")
        print("B")
